about.heroSubtitle: CineGenius connects creatives with locations, crew, equipment and jobs — for film, photography, social media and advertising in the DACH region.
about.missionP1: Anyone who has searched for a location knows the problem: hours of Googling, Instagram DMs, phone chains — and maybe one reply in the end.
about.missionP2: Anyone who wanted to book crew ended up at expensive agencies or happened to know the right people. Renting equipment was a matter of knowledge and trust.
about.missionP3: CineGenius brings locations, crew, talent, companies and offers together. Discover suitable contacts and agree availability, prices and collaboration directly.
about.missionPoint1: Locations, crew, equipment and jobs in one place
about.missionPoint2: Direct communication — no agency, no fees
about.missionPoint3: Discover companies and services including catering
about.missionPoint4: List for free and get found
about.valuesSubtitle: The principles behind every decision we make.
about.value1Desc: Every feature was born from real needs on set, at a shoot or during content production — not from a textbook.
about.value2Desc: Fair chances for everyone involved. Transparent terms protect both providers and seekers.
about.value3Desc: Contact providers directly and agree how to work together without an intermediary agency.
about.value4Desc: Better a few good listings than thousands of mediocre ones. We grow deliberately, slowly and thoroughly.
about.ctaDesc: Whether location owner, freelancer, company or seeker — CineGenius is for everyone who works creatively.

pricing.heroBadge: No subscription. No fees. No commission.
pricing.heroSubtitle: Search, profiles, listings and messages are currently free. Agree service and rental costs with the provider.
pricing.pillar1Desc: Register, complete the guided setup and publish offers — with no promised completion time.
pricing.pillar2Desc: No platform commission for the currently free features. Offer prices are agreed by the parties.
pricing.pillar3Desc: Direct communication and individual visibility settings.
pricing.feature10: Currently free platform access — no subscription
pricing.categoriesDesc: No difference — the same free usage everywhere.
pricing.faq1A: Platform access is currently free. Clarify offer prices and additional costs with the provider.
pricing.faq2A: We are currently fully focused on growth and community building. Future monetization (e.g. optional premium features) will be communicated transparently — core features remain free.
pricing.faq3A: No. No commission, no service fee, no platform fee. What you see is the price that provider and buyer agree directly.
pricing.faq4A: Bookings are handled directly between the parties. The payment integration (Stripe) is still in development — until then, settlement is by individual agreement.
pricing.faq5Q: Can I use CineGenius as a company?
pricing.faq5A: Companies and service providers including catering can create company profiles with multiple industries, services and confirmed team memberships.
pricing.ctaDesc: Sign up, create your profile and get started — no risk, no cost.

AiTransparency.imagesBody: The “AI-generated” label applies to the specific decorative website image. It was artificially generated and is not a documentary photograph. The label does not mean that all images on CineGenius were created with AI.
AiTransparency.membersBody: Members’ photographs, company logos, work samples and listing images are not classified as AI-generated by this website notice. We do not infer an image’s origin from its appearance alone.
AiTransparency.contactBody: If you have questions about AI use or notice an incorrect label, please contact us with a link to the relevant page.
AiTransparency.imageLabelAccessible: AI-generated website image – open information about AI use

ProjectMediaRights.title: Image rights for this project
ProjectMediaRights.explanation: Only publish images you are entitled to use. An image on IMDb or another website is not permission to use it. No confirmation is needed without images.
ProjectMediaRights.sourceHint: For example, permission from the film company, an authorised press kit or a licence reference. Do not include confidential documents here.
ProjectMediaRights.confirm: I confirm that I am entitled to display these specific images publicly on CineGenius and can grant the required usage rights.
ProjectMediaRights.required: Please confirm the image rights and provide the rights holder and, where applicable, the basis of permission. You can also publish the project without images.
ProjectMediaRights.pageDescription: Information about project images and reporting missing rights.
ProjectMediaRights.pageHeading: Project images require a basis for use
ProjectMediaRights.pageBody: Project posters and photos are only displayed publicly after a responsible person has confirmed their authorisation for the specific images. This confirmation is not an official review and does not replace any permission actually required.
ProjectMediaRights.reportBody: Please send the project link, identify the image and describe the issue. If you claim rights yourself, explain who holds them and how we can contact you. We review reports and may suspend display while clarifying the issue.
ProjectMediaRights.limitBody: A download or an image credit alone does not grant usage rights. The publishing person remains responsible for an accurate confirmation.

ContentUsageNotice.configured: Public visibility depends on publication approval and your visibility settings. Uploading alone does not publish a private draft.
ContentUsageNotice.short: Photos are optional. Only upload content you are allowed to use here.
ContentUsageNotice.rights: Your rights remain with you or the respective rights holders. Also respect the rights of people shown and rights in logos. CineGenius may store, resize and deliver images for the platform features you choose. External advertising requires a separate basis.
ContentUsageNotice.private: This draft and its images are not public.
ContentUsageNotice.restricted: Only people authorised by your settings can see this content. It is excluded from public Community discovery.
ContentUsageNotice.pending: Your submission stays non-public until approved.

public.profile: Public profile photos, covers and directly uploaded portfolio photos may also appear in Community insights.
public.company: Public company logos, covers and gallery photos may also appear in Community insights.
public.offer: Public listing images may appear in relevant directories and search results. They are excluded from Community insights.
public.project: Public project images may appear in project views. They are excluded from Community insights.
public.board: Public post images may appear with the post and in relevant directories. They are excluded from Community insights.
